query:
SELECT series_title as "series_title!: String",
                      MAX(is_favorite) as "fav!: i64",
                      MAX(is_in_watchlist) as "wl!: i64"
               FROM series_episodes
               WHERE source_id = ?
               GROUP BY series_title
               HAVING MAX(is_favorite) = 1 OR MAX(is_in_watchlist) = 1
